authority.note: Sealed 2026-10-05 BEFORE any R was computed on the XAUUSD measurement corpus (the corpus is not present in the cloud clone that wrote this contract and the code; only synthetic bars were walked while building it, and synthetic numbers are never evidence). QUESTION (user, 2026-10-05): at which CRT ENGINE state-transition events does a hypothetical entry carry positive multi_tp_walk R over N future candles, ignoring intrabar ordering? OBJECT: engine transition EVENTS (the bar a state is entered), not state OCCUPANCY. F-086 tested resolver occupancy (0 of 84 cells) and F-106 tested engine SWEEP occupancy (= random); neither measured the transition event, and F-069 shows the resolver is not the engine. The production entry is the RETEST close confirmed one bar later (F-110); every earlier transition is an entry the engine never trades. PRIMARY ARM = close_only (user decision 2026-10-05: 'ignore intrabar'): stops and targets trigger only on a bar CLOSE. The production SL-first high/low walk (F-088) runs beside it as a REFERENCE arm that spends no alpha. A POSITIVE verdict is information (Authority Ladder rung 1): it grants no fusion weight, no ExecutionPlanner/Ultron change, no ACTIVE_VERSION change and no G001. economic_claims_allowed stays false while mt00/mt01 are UNRUN (repo-wide 0/27 probes).

population.inclusion_rule: MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv (the standing probe corpus; sha256 and row count are recorded in population_fingerprint.json at run time, never assumed). EVENT SOURCE = the <instrument>_events.jsonl of ONE BacktestRunner run of the ACTIVE config (configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION) over that corpus, run unmodified; the run's config_hash is recorded. One unit = (setup, entry_kind, direction). A SETUP starts at an engine SWEEP event (its direction is the setup direction, state.direction = sweep.direction, crt_engine_v2.try_range_to_sweep) and ends at the next SWEEP event. ENTRY KINDS (sealed): ENTER_SWEEP (STATE_TRANSITION state_to=SWEEP), ENTER_SHADOW_PENDING, ENTER_DISPLACEMENT, ENTER_EXPANSION, ENTER_RETEST (= the retest close, resting_order semantics), EXECUTION_LEGACY (TRADE_OPENED: entry = the event price = retest close, levels = the event's own sl/tp1/tp2, walked from the bar AFTER the approval bar: reproduces the backtest ledger object), EXECUTION_AT_APPROVAL (TRADE_OPENED: entry = the approval bar close, same SL level, TP1/TP2 re-anchored at the same R multiples), REJECTED_AT_CONFIRMATION (FILTER_REJECTED, SHADOW_ADVISORY_BLOCK, TRADE_BUILD_REJECTED, TRADE_UNCONFIRMED events: the setups the engine refused, measured as a counterfactual). At most ONE unit per (setup, entry_kind). Events are joined to bars by TIMESTAMP, never by candle_index (the engine's candle_index is its own counter and does not equal the corpus row).
population.exclusion_rule: Excluded: events with no setup direction (no SWEEP seen yet); units whose entry bar lacks the full horizon of forward bars (counted per horizon as insufficient_forward); units whose SL is on the wrong side of entry (the engine's inverted-SL guard; counted); units with non-positive ATR. Excluded objects: opportunities.jsonl detections (F-022), resolver occupancy (F-069/F-086), every-bar labels (F-086 owns those), the F-086 236-bar stride holdout (stays unspent), the 1-month visual-audit corpus data/XAUUSD_M15.csv.

features.point_in_time_rule: Decision time t = the close of the event bar. The engine emits the event from bars <= t (process_candle is causal), so entering at the event-bar close uses no future information. EXECUTION_LEGACY deliberately reproduces the backtest's stale fill (entry = retest close while the decision is made one bar later, F-110); it is a PARITY arm, and EXECUTION_AT_APPROVAL is its honest counterpart. The forward walk receives only bars strictly after the entry bar (multi_tp_walk entry_index guard). The engine's own feature path carries F-051 (centered swings) and F-061/F-064 (momentum_score scale) exactly as the active config runs it; this contract measures the engine AS RUN and does not claim those defects are absent.

atr_abs.formula_ref: price-unit ATR: the engine's own STATE_TRANSITION metadata.atr when the event carries it, else research.indicators.atr (simple mean of 14 true ranges over bars <= t)

structural_stop.formula_ref: ENTER_SWEEP: sweep candle low/high -/+ sl_atr_buffer*atr_abs (the engine's sl_anchor='sweep_extreme' arithmetic). Every later kind: displacement candle (the bar of SWEEP->DISPLACEMENT) low/high -/+ sl_atr_buffer*atr_abs (the engine's active sl_anchor='displacement' arithmetic, ExecutionEngine.stop_price). sl_atr_buffer read from crt_engine at run time.

forbidden_aliases: resolver crt_state_resolved as the engine state
state occupancy as a transition event

labels.y_definition: y = R of the SEM-017 two-target trade from research.oracle.multi_tp_walk: partial_fraction = execution_planner.partial_tp_fraction, trail_fraction 0.5 (the production half-way trail), runner_stop_pricing ledger_blend, timeout_pricing mark_to_close at the horizon. GEOMETRY ARMS: structural (stop per features.name_binding.structural_stop) and fixed_atr (stop = entry -/+ sl_tp_comparison.legacy_sl_atr_mult*atr_abs, the oracle labeler's fixed_atr arm). TP1 = crt_engine.tp1_atr_multiplier * risk, TP2 = crt_engine.tp2_atr_multiplier * risk (intent-specific TP1 needs RETEST-cached features that earlier events do not have, so the base multiplier is used for every kind except EXECUTION_LEGACY, which keeps the engine's own levels). y_gross = rr_gross; y_net = y_gross - ComponentCostModel.cost_r(entry, risk, exit_kind, direction).
labels.sign_convention: LONG positive when price rises; SHORT positive when price falls; R = pnl / initial_risk. HORIZONS (sealed): 4, 8, 16, 40, 96, 192, 480 M15 bars; 480 is the maximum and the value of horizon_bars above.

components.name: ontology_and_provenance
components.bps_or_formula: SEM-015 via src/research/costs.py::xau_measured_cost_model() (F-082 measured broker calibration). entry_leg = half_spread + commission + entry_slippage; exit_leg = half_spread + commission (+ stop_slippage only on a stop exit). Swap NOT charged (nights_held=0): horizons up to 480 bars span nights, so net at long horizons is OPTIMISTIC by the unmeasured swap; declared, not hidden. Net is DIAGNOSTIC.

components.name: stop_slippage
components.bps_or_formula: MEASURED 0.0900 USD/oz median (n=7), stop exits only

parameters.primary_arm: close_only: every forward bar is fed to the kernel with open=high=low=close, and AdverseFill(stop_slippage=0.0, model_gaps=True). A stop therefore triggers only when a bar CLOSES at/through it and fills AT THAT CLOSE (beyond the level, so losses can exceed -1R: honest for a close-triggered stop). A target triggers only on a close at/through it and fills AT THE LEVEL (conservative: a close-triggered exit would get the close). No intrabar ordering is assumed anywhere.
parameters.reference_arm: sl_first: real high/low bars, tie_break='production' (SL-first, F-088), AdverseFill(stop_slippage=0.0, model_gaps=True). Reported beside the primary arm; spends no alpha.
parameters.timeout: mark_to_close at the horizon (TP1 partial already realised; runner marks to the last close)

exits.intrabar_rule: PRIMARY: close_only (no intrabar information is used). REFERENCE: SL-first over high/low. F-087: close-triggered arms have a ~0.0005R same-bar ambiguity band; extreme-reading arms 0.261R, so only the primary arm is rankable.

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between the cut and the first holdout entry
splits.purge: a train unit is kept only if entry_row + horizon < cut_row (its exit window cannot reach the holdout); evaluated per horizon
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: cut_row = floor(0.70 * corpus_rows); holdout = units with entry_row >= cut_row + 96. The cut timestamp is written to split_manifest.json at run time. The holdout is touched exactly once.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, promotes nothing. CELL = entry_kind x direction x geometry x horizon on the PRIMARY (close_only) arm. FAMILY = every cell with train n >= 30 (the family size is fixed before p-values are read and recorded in metrics.json). TRAIN: one-sided p for mean_net_R > 0 from a normal approximation on the cell's units (t = mean / (sd/sqrt(n))). BH-FDR at q = 0.10 over the family. A cell is POSITIVE only if ALL hold: (1) survives BH on train; (2) holdout n >= 30; (3) holdout mean_net_R > 0; (4) SHORT cells only: holdout mean_net_R > the long_only control's holdout mean on the same units (direction forced long, same stop distance and R multiples; the binding control on a corpus where gold trended up). For LONG cells forcing the unit long reproduces it exactly, so this clause is vacuous; their passive-drift control is clause (5), whose random draws are LONG entries matched by hour and stop distance, i.e. passive long exposure. [AMENDED 2026-10-05 before any real-corpus R was computed: the sealed wording applied clause (4) to long cells, where it can never be satisfied. Caught while writing the floor, not after seeing results.]; (5) holdout mean_net_R exceeds the random_entry control mean in >= 95 of 100 seeded draws (each draw: same n, same direction, same hour-of-day, same stop distance in ATR units, entry bars drawn from the holdout window). Otherwise: NEGATIVE (train or holdout mean_net <= 0), NOT_SIGNIFICANT, FAILS_CONTROL, or INSUFFICIENT (n < 30). Long-horizon results are additionally reported against passive drift because the uptrend inflates long cells (F-086/F-087).
metrics.kill_criteria: NON-NEGOTIABLE. Any outcome is a RESULT TO REGISTER, not an invitation to retune. Changing entry kinds, geometry, horizons, arms, cost model, split, controls or the BH q after seeing outcomes requires a NEW MC-* id. Choosing the best-looking cell and reporting it without the family correction is forbidden. A POSITIVE on the reference (sl_first) arm alone is not a POSITIVE. The EXECUTION_LEGACY arm is a parity check against the backtest ledger and can never be the headline (its fill is stale by construction, F-110).

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION, read at run time and recorded; the backtest that emits the events runs the active config unmodified
modules_explicitly_out_of_path: src/research/oracle/labeler.py (geometry mirrored, not imported; the every-bar label set is F-086's object)

Use opportunities.outcome / rr_achieved or the trade ledger's rr as y
Report the sl_first reference arm, or an optimistic target-first tie-break, as the primary result
Select a cell after seeing outcomes, or report any cell without the BH-FDR family correction and both controls
Present diagnostic expectancy as economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false
Run the event-emitting backtest on a config other than ACTIVE_VERSION, or with BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE overriding the config, without recording it as a different object
